Definition: to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general
BiblicalUsage: 1) to fear, tremble, revere, dread, be in awe or dread; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be in dread; 1a2) to be in awe; 1b) (Piel) to be in great dread; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to dread
